messages:
Dana (Hiring): Quick sync  Rosa accepted the senior ML engineer role but she's on an O-1 petition. Candidate wants to start ASAP. Can we do a tentative start before USCIS decision if we file premium processing?
Emily (People Ops): We can plan a "soft start" (no US payroll) for remote onboarding, but cannot put her on US payroll or benefits until admitted if working in US. If she stays abroad, different rules. Need immigration confirmation + payroll rules.
Rosa (Candidate): Im in Spain now. Id like to start working remotely immediately. O-1 petition will be filed with PP. If approved, I'll travel and switch to US payroll. Fine with remote until then.
Priya (Immigration Counsel): O-1 with premium processing usually returns a decision within 15 calendar days; still not guaranteed. Remote work from Spain is allowed but tax/residence implications apply. If she works remotely as an employee of Redwood while abroad, we must consider local employer obligations. Recommend either: 1) remote unpaid ramp (not ideal), 2) contractor/EOR in Spain, or 3) remote employment via EOR until entry. Also note: starting work before O-1 entry has no impact on US admission, but billing as contractor may trigger local tax. We'll draft advisory for candidate.
Alex (Payroll): Operational: we can't put her on US payroll until she is physically in US and admitted in O-1 status. If she enters on O-1, I-9 must be completed within 3 business days after start. If she starts remote from Spain as an employee, we need a legal entity there or EOR. Payroll needs bank + tax docs in time for first run; otherwise retro pay possible but a pain.
Ned (Recruiter): Rosa, would you prefer EOR in Spain, contractor invoice, or wait for entry? We can cover EOR fees for initial month if that helps.
Rosa (Candidate): EOR looks best. Id rather not be a contractor. If Redwood covers initial EOR fees, Im happy to start immediately. Would love clarity on benefits transition once I move to US.
Emily (People Ops): If EOR: limited local benefits through partner; US benefits (health, 401k) start only when on US payroll. We'll create a transition checklist to port her into US benefits upon entry. We'll also document equity vesting treatment during EOR period.
Priya (Immigration Counsel): Action: we'll file O-1 with premium processing tomorrow pending materials. I'll cc counsel phone in the support letter. Draft language will note anticipated start and request expedited PP. If USCIS issues an RFE, that could delay entry. Contingency plan needed.
Dana (Hiring): Sounds good. Timeline: file PP today, aim for decision within 15 days. Nina please set up EOR quote and draft transition checklist. (Ned to coordinate).
visa-bot: Reminder: add "o1-pp-filing" tag to candidate record and set 14-day follow-up. :white_check_mark:
Alex (Payroll): Also note tax residency: if Rosa works >183 days in Spain she'll have local tax obligations. Global Mobility to advise. For payroll, send bank + ID to EOR partner.
Rosa (Candidate): Thanks everyone. Please send EOR paperwork and the drafted support letter. Happy to provide any materials for O-1 petition right away.
Emily (People Ops): We'll cover the first month of EOR fees to get her ramping. Once O-1 approved and she crosses, we'll onboard to US payroll with retro pay for EOR period if appropriate. Priya: please post the signed support letter when ready.
Priya (Immigration Counsel): Will send signed support letter and PP receipt once filed. Will include counsel contact and note contingency if RFE or denial occurs.
Dana (Hiring): Great work team. Welcome aboard Rosa  excited to get you started.
